existing_correlation_intervals: Reused from final analysis (1,000 image-cluster replicates).

figures.name: 01_workflow
figures.title: Study workflow and evaluation subsets
figures.note: The three analysis branches overlap. TR uses the common all-four-applicable subset, while CIDEr excludes images without valid reference captions. The separate blur pilot contains 200 different images.

figures.name: 02_blur_analysis
figures.title: Blur scores, calibration and reserved evaluation
figures.note: Whiskers extend to 1.5 IQR; dots are outliers. The score axis is logarithmic and the threshold axis is symmetric-logarithmic. The fixed threshold achieved 77% calibration and 71% reserved-set balanced accuracy. It was not validated for low-light or text classification.

figures.name: 03_human_scores
figures.title: Human scores across image conditions
figures.note: Dots are means of four-reviewer caption means; whiskers are image-bootstrap 95% intervals. TR contains 50 text-group images and one blurry image per model. There are no common-applicable TR observations in the clear or low-light groups. No confidence interval is shown for the single blurry image; its value is descriptive only.

figures.name: 04_reviewer_agreement_unweighted
figures.title: Unweighted reviewer agreement
figures.note: Unweighted Cohen kappa for each reviewer pair. Mirrored cells repeat the same six pairs; diagonal cells are omitted. Both panels use a fixed 0–1 colour scale. TR is pairwise-applicable score agreement. The underlying table preserves full precision.

figures.name: 05_reviewer_agreement_linear_weighted
figures.title: Linear-weighted reviewer agreement
figures.note: Linear-weighted Cohen kappa for each reviewer pair. Mirrored cells repeat the same six pairs; diagonal cells are omitted. Both panels use a fixed 0–1 colour scale. TR is pairwise-applicable score agreement. The underlying table preserves full precision.

figures.name: 06_score_distributions
figures.title: Human rating distributions
figures.note: Each bar pools individual ratings for one model: 1,000 EH ratings or 204 common-subset TR ratings. N/A is excluded from TR, never zero. These are individual-rating proportions, not rounded caption-mean scores.

figures.name: 07_correlations
figures.title: Spearman and Kendall correlations
figures.note: Both panels show ranking associations on −1 to 1 scales, with saved image-cluster 95% intervals. Each n is the number of paired caption scores. Model-specific values are descriptive; differences between correlations are not a formal significance test.

figures.name: 08_tr_applicability
figures.title: Human and judge text applicability
figures.note: All-four agreement determines the common human TR subset. This is a comparison of applicability judgments, not a correctness confusion matrix. N/A does not enter score correlations as zero.

figures.name: 09_eh_sensitivity
figures.title: Generation-flag sensitivity
figures.note: The primary and sensitivity estimates use the same fixed judge responses and final human scores. Overlapping intervals are not a formal test of the difference.

figures.name: 10_judge_score_pairs
figures.title: Human and judge score pairs
figures.note: Each circle represents a score combination; area is proportional to the number of captions. Labels show counts of at least five. The diagonal indicates equal numeric scores and is not a fitted regression line.

figures.name: 11_cider_human_scores
figures.title: CIDEr against human scores
figures.note: Only captions with valid reference-based CIDEr scores are shown. TR additionally requires all four humans to consider text applicable. Scores keep their original separate axes; no composite score or fitted line is imposed.

figures.name: 12_exploratory_taxonomy
figures.title: Exploratory automated failure categories
figures.note: Provisional keyword-based categories; not fully validated human coding and not independent validation of Gemini. One primary label per included caption. The majority-EH1 label is displayed without asserting that all such cases are over-hedging. Unlabelled captions are not shown.

tables.name: 01_dataset
tables.title: Dataset composition
tables.note: Train/validation describe the source VizWiz splits. These images evaluate pretrained models; they did not train the captioning models.

tables.name: 02_blur_scores
tables.title: Laplacian-variance summaries
tables.note: Descriptive measurements only. Original annotation-based image groups were retained.

tables.name: 03_blur_performance
tables.title: Blur heuristic performance
tables.note: Recall and balanced accuracy are proportions. Only calibration data selected the threshold; the reserved set evaluated that fixed rule.

tables.name: 04_blur_confusion
tables.title: Reserved-set blur confusion matrix
tables.note: Columns are predicted labels. Annotation labels are the reference; they are not assumed to be infallible ground truth.

tables.name: 05_coverage
tables.title: Review and analysis coverage
tables.note: N/A is not zero. Applicability disagreements remain in the source workbook but are excluded from the common numerical TR subset. EH and TR subsets overlap; do not add them.

tables.name: 06_applicability
tables.title: Human and judge TR applicability
tables.note: Counts are captions. Disagreement alone does not establish whether the humans or Gemini were correct.

tables.name: 07_human_model_scores
tables.title: Human scores by model and image condition
tables.note: Mean of per-caption four-reviewer means, on the 0–2 scale. Descriptive 95% percentile intervals use 2000 image-bootstrap replicates (seeds 20261119 + row index). No CI for fewer than two images; N/A means no eligible observations. These new mean-score intervals are distinct from the saved correlation intervals.

tables.name: 08_score_distribution
tables.title: Human rating distributions
tables.note: Individual ratings are descriptive; ratings for the same caption/image are not independent observations. TR uses only the common subset.

tables.name: 09_reviewer_agreement
tables.title: Pairwise reviewer agreement
tables.note: Six pairs, not a single four-rater Cohen kappa. TR score agreement requires both members of each pair to mark the caption applicable. Exact agreement is a proportion and differs from chance-corrected kappa.

tables.name: 10_team_agreement
tables.title: Mean of six reviewer-pair agreement values
tables.note: Arithmetic means of the six pairwise statistics. Final human-score snapshot; not a reconstruction of first-pass independent agreement.

tables.name: 11_correlations
tables.title: Human-score correlation results
tables.note: Saved image-cluster bootstrap 95% intervals (1,000 replicates). Spearman compares judge with human means; Kendall tau-b compares CIDEr with human means. They measure ranking association, not accuracy or exact agreement.

tables.name: 12_eh_sensitivity
tables.title: Generation-flag sensitivity analysis
tables.note: Primary analysis includes C0104. Sensitivity excludes that generation-flagged caption. This does not include the separate text-review sensitivity analysis, which is outside the main package.

tables.name: 13_score_pairs
tables.title: Human/judge score-pair frequencies
tables.note: Each caption contributes once. TR uses common applicability. Bubble area is proportional to caption count; numeric labels show counts of five or more.

tables.name: 14_cider_model_comparison
tables.title: Models compared on matched CIDEr subsets
tables.note: Both metrics in each row use exactly the same captions. EH uses 217 images/model; TR uses 50. CIDEr remains on its raw scale, not multiplied by 100. These are descriptive means, not a significance test or a combined score.

tables.name: 15_exploratory_taxonomy
tables.title: Exploratory automated failure categories
tables.note: Recorded labels are keyword-rule outputs, not validated human coding. The rule labelled vague/over-hedged includes all majority-EH1 cases and can include colour-only errors. Counts are captions, not images. Judge reasons influence some categories.

taxonomy: Exploratory taxonomy included; scores and IDs match the final human-score analysis.
separate_text_review_sensitivity: Not included: not part of the main human-score package.
